description_en: Queries the details of SMS configurations
description_zh: 使用ListSmsMetadata获取短信配置详情
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-sms-metadata --instance-id ccc-test --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --scenario-list-json SATISFACTION_SURVEY_,_CONTACT_FLOW_NODE --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSmsMetadata

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value ranges from 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value ranges from 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scenario. Valid values:

- SATISFACTION\_SURVEY: satisfaction survey

- CONTACT\_FLOW\_NODE: Interactive Voice Response (IVR) flow node

- MISSED\_CALL\_NOTIFICATION: missed call notification

- FLASH\_SMS: Alibaba Cloud flash SMS notification
parameters.help_zh:
场景类型。
- SATISFACTION_SURVEY（满意度调查）
- CONTACT_FLOW_NODE（IVR流程节点）
- MISSED_CALL_NOTIFICATION（漏话提醒）
- FLASH_SMS（阿里通信闪信通知）
parameters.name: scenario_list_json
